Dave Lee (@davelee)

Time for Tesla to take everything they learned from making the Cybercab and launch a new generation of AI-driven vehicles for people to buy.

The Cybercab marks a new line in the sand.  Everything before the Cybercab was primarily human-driven and designed to be so (ie., performance, handling, acceleration, etc).  But Cybercab and post-Cybercab vehicles are designed from ground-up to be driven by AI and for the passenger it's about comfort, calm/peace, entertainment, convenience, etc.

Further, the unboxed approach, RIM plastic outer shell, brake-by-wire, next iterations of drive train, thermal management, electronics, etc... all can be leveraged for a cheaper, more efficient and reliable next-gen consumer vehicles.

Think Cybercab but a 4-5 passenger model you can buy.  And a 6-7 passenger model you can buy.  Etc.

Would love to see Tesla explore the following:
Small sedan
Small CUV
Mid-size sedan
Mid-size SUV
Large SUV

关于 FSD 在中国的进度，一个正面消息是员工内测规模已经扩大至全体员工。但需要其实去年达沃斯论坛和今年股东大会，Elon 都说了有希望在今年 2 月或 3 月获批，之后 Elon 和特斯拉 CFO Vaibhav 在两次财报会上都说会在 Q3 具体是 8 月推送。今天是 9 月了，显然推送的限制不在 FSD 本土化进度。

对我来说，如果特斯拉突然官宣未经验证就成功将 Robotaxi 推广至某个新城市，要比在已运营的这些城市投放 200 台 CyberCab 更让人印象深刻。因为那是对泛化能力和信心的证明。
